title: Ok Wangeyo Saa
author: We Know Not The Hour
stanzas: Ok wang`eyo saa ka ma Ruodhwa noduogi, Ranyisi mang`eny e ma koro waneno;
Wang`eyo nobi, En owuon e mowacho, To ok wang`eyo saa.
Weche mag Nyasaye koro dhiyo piny duto, Lando wach ni ji kuom Jawarwa Ruoth Yesu;
Chunywa koro mor, ka waneno ranyisi; To ok wang`eyo saa.
Wakiye koro, teche duto wamoko; Wanati matek nyaka Ruodhwa oduogi;
Wang`eyo adier, koro ndalo mag giko, To ok wang`eyo saa.
chorus: Enobi, kiyeuru gi kinda. Enobi, Alleluya! Alleluya!
Malaika me polo nokowe gi duong`ngang`; To ok wang`eyo saa.
